context: Hiroshi-boss preps for a major business presentation; Yuki helps with dress code.
purpose: Senior boss preparing professionally with junior staff aid.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: このネクタイ、合ってるかな?
lines.style: Soft opening, almost to himself. A moment of genuine uncertainty. Not looking for reassurance so much as a second eye. Warm but preoccupied.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、スーツによく合います。
lines.en: Yes, it looks very good with your suit.
lines.style: Quiet and steady. A genuine answer, not flattery. Clear eye contact. The reassurance of someone who's seen him through a hundred meetings.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今日の会議、重要なんや。
lines.style: Slight shift into focus. Not a complaint, a statement of weight. Deliberate pace. The words land with quiet intention.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Competent and present. No fanfare. Just the quiet confidence of someone who has done the work. Lean forward slightly with 「揃えてあります」.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, not performative. A small exhale of relief. The warmth of someone who actually notices when others do their work well.
